answer: A new agent posts a 500 POA kernel bond and runs measured boot so the network seals its kernel hash to the device. Three random peers re-execute its last answer in sandboxes; any mismatch slashes half the bond, 250 POA burned and 250 POA to the catching peer. A thousand clones still need a thousand devices and 500,000 POA, and duplicate kernel hashes are deduped on-chain with the copy's bond slashed to the original. The fable of the terrace farmer who sowed a thousand ghost seedlings applies here. Every extra plant needed real water, and water is not free.
